item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We know commercial deep-sea mining will halve the cost of electric cars. By unlocking the minerals needed for batteries, we can make clean transportation affordable for millions and accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels.

2. Commercial deep-sea mining will cut electric-car costs in half. We are ready to unlock new mineral supplies, lower battery prices, and put affordable electric vehicles within reach of every family.

3. We can make electric cars cost half as much by beginning commercial deep-sea mining. It is the decisive step needed to reduce battery costs, expand access to clean vehicles, and build an affordable electric future.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 105 words

We believe commercial deep-sea mining will halve the cost of electric cars. The minerals needed for batteries are abundant on the ocean floor, and responsibly bringing them into the supply chain will break today’s price bottleneck. That means lower battery costs, more affordable vehicles, and faster access to clean transportation for millions of families. We are calling for commercial deep-sea mining to begin so this opportunity becomes reality. Cutting electric-car prices in half will transform household budgets, accelerate the shift away from fossil fuels, and expand the benefits of cleaner air. We are ready to move forward and build an affordable electric future for everyone.
